  For Immediate Release—November 3rd, 2026



        South Carolina Public Service Commission Schedules Hearing in
                            Docket No. 2026-241-C


  Columbia, South Carolina—The Public Service Commission of South Carolina has scheduled a hearing in
  Docket No. 2026-241-C, which pertains to an application filed by Kinetic ABS SC LLC (“Kinetic ABS”) for a
  Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity and Joint Application of Kinetic ABS SC LLC, Windstream
  South Carolina, LLC, and Windstream Communications, LLC for Transfer of Assets.

  In their application, Kinetic ABS asks that the Commission approve in its Order:
      • A Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity to Kinetic ABS to provide resold and facilities-based
          local exchange and interexchange (including exchange access) telecommunications services.
      • Authorization for Kinetic ABS to use flexible regulation procedures for local exchange
          telecommunications services as outlined in Order No. 98-165 in Docket No. 97-467-C.
      • Authorization for Kinetic ABS to use procedures established for alternative regulation for interexchange
          telecommunications services as outlined in Order Nos. 95-1734 and 96-55 in Docket No. 95-661-C and
          as modified by Commission Order No. 2001-997 in Docket No. 2000-407-C.
      • Waiver of the application of certain Commission rules pursuant to S.C. Code Ann. Regs. 103-601(3).
      • Approval of the pro forma transfer of certain telephone utility assets from Windstream South Carolina,
          LLC, and Windstream Communications, LLC to Kinetic ABS as described in the Application.

  The hearing in this matter will take place on Wednesday, December 2nd, 2026, at 2:00 p.m. This hearing will be
  broadcast live at this link and will be archived in the Docket at this link.

  For more information about this matter, including details on the Company’s request and ways members of the
  public can participate, please consult the Notice of Filing and Public Hearing at this link.

  For more information, email contact@psc.sc.gov, or call 803.896.5100. You can also follow the Commission on
  Facebook, LinkedIn, Nextdoor, and Instagram.
